CustomField.description: A self-contained "data:image/jpeg;base64,..." data URI holding the shopper's profile photo, resized to ~200x200 and JPEG-compressed client-side (techBasketMyAccount.js) before upload so it comfortably fits this field's size limit. Deliberately not a Salesforce File/ContentVersion — this login system has no real Salesforce User to own a File under, and Guest User access to Files requires sharing configuration this simple approach avoids entirely, the same reasoning Cart_Items__c already uses for storing structured data as plain text instead of a related object. Blank means the shopper hasn't uploaded one yet — the UI falls back to a generated initials avatar.
CustomField.label: Profile Photo
